Proposition
[Structure of the ending lamination] 1. 9.3.7,9.3.8,9.3.9\group thurston.ch09.endingSource: thurston:page-0257Source: thurston:page-0258 For every compact subset of $E$, sufficiently far-out bounded-length curves converge to $\epsilon (E)$. Every leaf of $\epsilon (E)$ is dense in it, and every nontrivial closed curve intersects it. A compactly supported lamination admitting arbitrarily short realizations exiting the end is therefore a sublamination of $\epsilon (E)$.
